description: GNU stream editor for filtering and transforming text.

option.name: --binary
tip: Open input files in binary mode.
Only effective where the operating system distinguishes text and binary files.

option.name: --debug
tip: Print the input sed program in canonical form, and annotate program execution.

option.name: --expression
tip: Add the commands in script to the set of commands to be run while processing the input.

option.name: --file
tip: Add the commands contained in script-file to the set of commands to be run while processing the input.

option.name: --follow-symlinks
tip: Follow symlinks when processing in place.
Only effective with --in-place, and only on platforms that support symbolic links.

option.name: --in-place
tip: Edit files in place, making a backup if SUFFIX is supplied.
The suffix must be attached, e.g. -i.bak or --in-place=.bak.
Implies --separate.

option.name: --line-length
tip: Specify the default line-wrap length for the l command.
A length of 0 means never wrap long lines; the default is 70.
Never wrap long lines.
Default line-wrap length.

option.name: --posix
tip: Disable all GNU extensions.

option.name: --regexp-extended
tip: Use extended regular expressions rather than basic regular expressions.
-E is the POSIX spelling and is more portable than -r.

option.name: --sandbox
tip: Operate in sandbox mode (disable e/r/w commands).

option.name: --separate
tip: Consider files as separate rather than as a single, continuous long stream.

option.name: --silent
tip: Suppress automatic printing of pattern space.
Output is produced only when explicitly requested with commands such as p.

option.name: --unbuffered
tip: Load minimal amounts of data from the input files and flush the output buffers more often.

option.name: --zero-terminated
tip: Separate lines by NUL characters.
Can be used with commands such as sort -z and find -print0 to process arbitrary file names.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display this help and exit.

global_option.name: --version
tip: Output version information and exit.
